video.title: AI欧腐《背着姐姐撩姐夫/Seducing My Sister's Husband Behind Her Back》
video.desc:
As William and Fiona's relationship begins to crumble, Fiona's younger brother, Leon, sees his chance to make a move. He urges the ever-honorable William to get back at Fiona by cheating, and even offers to help him "practice." William still sees Leon as the boy he's looked after since childhood, unaware that Leon has spent years plotting to make him his. But as they cross one boundary after another, William is horrified to realize he's falling for Leon. Consumed by guilt, he tries to walk away, only for Leon to chase after him and finally confess the love he's kept buried for ten years.
William和Fiona的婚姻亮起红灯，Fiona的弟弟Leon等这一天已经等了太久。他劝正人君子William"以牙还牙"出轨报复，还自告奋勇陪他"练手"。William只当他是自己从小看着长大的弟弟，却不知这一切都是Leon蓄谋多年的局。界线一次次被打破，William惊觉自己竟然动了心。满心愧疚的他转身想逃，Leon却紧追不放，终于说出口：这份爱，他藏了整整十年。
